releaseTag: v0.1.14 core + expanded game assets + reviewed GPU and computer prototypes
provenance: Preserves the bridge-owned v0.1.14 core with complete u64 browser clock results and PR 201's 32-compilation GPU capability using the reviewed GPU runtime. The bridge core and browser workers pin pvm-host-runtime#45, raising the bounded package asset ceilings to 128 MiB per file and 256 MiB aggregate so complete libre game data sets can run. The separately pinned pvm-computer.js adapter adds shared filesystem checkpoints, host-supervised workspaces and cancellation-safe package resolution.
